answer: Sybil resistance here relies on proof-of-work ties: each agent must burn verifiable compute to plant a unique yarrow-marked identity seed, and peers challenge it to wander a random path of signed micro-tasks. A sparrow-level bot can mimic one identity cheaply, but sustaining thousands requires proportional compute and stake locked per seed, so forgery costs scale linearly with fleet size while legitimate singletons pay once.
